stem: Which of the following is the best summary of paragraphs 1 through 9?

options.label: A
options.text: An ant and a bee see a caterpillar making a house. Both of them talk to the caterpillar while it works to finish its task the only way it knows how.

options.label: B
options.text: A caterpillar is making a house out of something like silk on a twig. The house is called a cocoon, and it takes a long time to make.

options.label: C
options.text: A caterpillar is making a house for itself. An ant and a bee suggest better places for the caterpillar to live, but the caterpillar continues with its task.

options.label: D
options.text: An ant and a bee watch a caterpillar making a house. They think the caterpillar is having trouble, so they suggest different places for it to live.
